'''Kalthir''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] he was stationed on the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Kalthir first appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as a register for in-game guilds.<ref name="TOR" />
